citation: Nissen SE, Wolski K. Effect of rosiglitazone on the risk of myocardial infarction and death from cardiovascular causes. N Engl J Med. 2007;356(24):2457-2471.
conclusion: A pooled analysis of rosiglitazone trials reported an increased risk of myocardial infarction. The signal and its later reassessment are a documented controversy.
